summary: Liveranov showcases a Dauntless lineup against the Chaos Hunter, the Area Boss 1 of the Crisis Rally event. The team scores over 9.22 billion total damage, comfortably securing an S rank. Guinavivre serves as the primary carry, dealing over 79% of the team's total damage, supported by Nastjenka as secondary DPS. Full equipment and stat setups are detailed for each hero on the team.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Built full damage and ideally aiming for 0.5s attack interval, delivering nearly 7.3 billion damage.

heroes.name: Nastjenka
heroes.note: Built full damage with high Attack and Crit Rate, dealing over 1.8 billion damage.

heroes.name: Kurvida
heroes.note: Built on the Puppeteer set paired with Witches Remains and sufficient Accuracy.

heroes.name: Fathomdown
heroes.note: Built with full Skill Haste to maximize buff rotation.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Built with sufficient Accuracy to guarantee debuff application.

teams.note: Dealt over 9.22B damage for S-rank; Guinavivre and Nastjenka provide the damage while Kurvida, Fathomdown, and Maashtur support.

tips: Build Guinavivre with full damage and aim for an attack interval around 0.5s.
Equip Kurvida with the Puppeteer set and Witches Remains artifact with roughly 230+ Accuracy.
Focus full Skill Haste on Fathomdown and ensure Maashtur has around 250+ Accuracy.
title: Dauntless vs Chaos Hunter (Area Boss 1) | Crisis Rally | Season 8 | Dragonheir
